messages.text: When are you going to be restocked for the Bitfortun BS-1
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04
Handed to the team · No restock date exists for the BS-1 and I won't guess one.

The BS-1 is sold out in both colours right now, and I don't have a restock date for it, so I won't guess one. I've asked the team for the current answer, they'll come back in this chat, and by email if you step away.

If you don't want to wait, the Hammer BC04 is in stock and ships in a few days. 6 TH/s at about 100W for $239, so more hashrate than the BS-1 for ten dollars more. Want me to set that up?
let me think about that. I will order once i decide.

Sounds good. The BC04 link is on the site whenever you're ready, and the team will still post back here about the BS-1.

Before you go, one thing: what's drawing you to the BS-1 specifically over the other small miners?
Any time. Take your time deciding, and we'll be here when you're ready.
Just a review on youtube was not aware of the hammer miner.

Makes sense, the BC04 gets less coverage than it deserves.

Which review was it? Knowing whose video sends people to the BS-1 helps us get the comparison in front of them.
Got it, thanks, that's useful to know.
Red Fox Crypto, noted. Thanks for that, and enjoy the rest of your day.
